title: The Discount Applied to Room Money before Statutory Tax on a Hotel Rate Plans Stay
content:
The room money the statutory tax acts on over a Hotel Rate Plans stay is reduced by a discount before the rate is applied. Whether there is one, and how large, turns on the membership standing in the guest's name in the Wanderlane Traveller Club and on whether the reservation carries a corporate programme reference.

## The rule

1. Where an active traveller club membership carrying a hotel rate discount stands in the guest's name and the reservation carries no corporate programme reference, the discount applied to the room money is the hotel rate discount of the tier the membership stands at.
2. Where an active traveller club membership stands in the guest's name and the reservation carries a corporate programme reference, the discount applied is 0 percent because the negotiated rate stands alone.
3. Where no active traveller club membership stands in the guest's name, the discount applied is 0 percent.

## Where the figures are read from

The membership and the tier it stands at are read from the Wanderlane Traveller Club membership record standing in the guest's name, and the hotel rate discount is the one that tier carries. The corporate programme reference is the one recorded on the hotel reservation itself; a reservation carrying none is a consumer booking for this purpose.

## The combinations

| Active traveller club membership in the guest's name | Corporate programme reference on the reservation | Discount applied to the room money |
| --- | --- | --- |
| yes | no | the hotel rate discount of the tier held |
| yes | yes | 0 percent |
| no | no | 0 percent |
| no | yes | 0 percent |

## Worked on hypothetical figures

Room money the tax acts on of 1,600.00 USD, with a hypothetical hotel rate discount of 6 percent carried by the tier the membership stands at:

- With an active membership and no corporate programme reference on the reservation, the taxable room money is 1,600.00 USD reduced by 6 percent, which is 1,504.00 USD.
- With an active membership and a corporate programme reference on the reservation, the discount is 0 percent and the taxable room money stands at 1,600.00 USD.
- With no active membership, the discount is again 0 percent and the taxable room money stands at 1,600.00 USD.
